scope.graph_discovery: No native graph discovery/reference tools were exposed; scoped source, consumer and contract reads were used.
scope.fixture_confinement: Regression autouse fixture replaces Path.home and cwd before importing helpers. Independent adversarial fixture additionally confines environment HOME and BABYLON_HOME. Every deletion target is under TemporaryDirectory/pytest tmp_path; no main/global cohorts are called.

finding_assessment.basis: run_auto_purge no longer deletes SQLite sidecars or whole __pycache__ directories. It unlinks only regular .pyc files with interpreter magic under __pycache__, anchored to cwd; active WAL/read/write and cache controls pass.

run_cohort_1 uses cwd or its explicit workspace, traverses descriptor-relative without following symlinks, and removes only recognized regular .pyc. It never traverses CORTEX_DIR or classifies WAL/SHM as orphans. Other-workspace cache and active SQLite controls pass. Other cohorts/main remain outside this assessment.

Both copies remove the WAL/SHM purge and blanket directory removal, reserve recognized SQLite names and DB/WAL/rollback headers, preserve failed inspection and protected subtrees, and count no recovered bytes in dry-run. Active databases inside scratch/out/cache and 23 interleaved committed writer steps per copy survive with integrity_check=ok.
The bundled copy has identical bytes to the primary source and runs the same parameterized SQLite, confinement, dry-run and writer regressions.

Both copies remove sqlite3 and global-session maintenance. purge_anergy does not call Path.home or open global databases, reports NOT_CHECKED, and preserves two fixture sessions from different workspaces with an access spy.

No durable JournalEntry schema/producer was found in the scoped code/contracts. autoconsolidate and load/merge/save all reject before opening or resolving a database path. Originals and new-writer ability survive; CLI returns 2. This disables the unsafe operation; no replacement persistence or functioning consolidation is claimed.

Round3 primary and bundled records cite the same unconditional home-directory conversation status reset. Both sources were byte-identical before and remain byte-identical after the patch. Removal of global lookup/update and dual-copy temporary-HOME/access-spy tests resolve this duplicate as well; no additional production behavior was changed.

source_checks.observation: No subprocess/find/rmtree/SQLite-sidecar deletion. Cwd rootfd, fwalk without symlink following, .pyc magic and inode checks, regular-file-only unlink; failures preserve candidates.
Only cohort_1 was reviewed/executed. Default scope is cwd instead of global WORKSPACE; no CORTEX_DIR access, dry-run guards unlink/counts, protected subtrees remain.
Unsupported error is the sole operation outcome after positive integer batch validation. All persistence helpers fail explicitly; no database API/path resolution remains.
Protect canonical components/subpaths, SQLite database/sidecar/superjournal names before considering artifact categories.

No broad directory removal. Inspect regular-file header through nofollow descriptor, preserve SQLite magic and unknown .pyc, recheck inode, then unlink by directory fd. Count recovered size only after unlink succeeds.
Dry-run and unexamined global sessions stated explicitly; CLI refuses errors and never calls global-session cleanup. Display now identifies the counter as logical file bytes removed.
Byte-identical implementation; tested separately through the same regression and independent fixtures.
Caller invokes run_auto_purge before subsequent git operations. Caller was read only and never executed; its other effects are not approved by this review.
Autouse temporary HOME-method/cwd fixture runs before helper imports, including cohort global path constants.

Additional tests reserve SQLite magic under deceptive artifact suffixes, superjournals, symlink roots, 3 warmup + 20 committed-writer interleavings per copy, refusing legacy JournalEntry helpers and CLI.
C0223 is unchanged and OPEN: cohort 2 iterates global WORKSPACE and calls rmtree on every unprotected .lake without proving archived state. Read only, never executed.

limitations: Consolidation is deliberately unavailable. An explicit durable schema, payload/causal merge contract and transactional persistence implementation remain required before functional resolution of C0460.

Descriptor-relative O_NOFOLLOW and inode recheck protect the tested symlink/replacement cases. They do not make inspection plus unlink atomic against a hostile rename after the final stat; source documents this limit.
SQLite preservation recognizes the listed plaintext DB/WAL/rollback magic and sidecar names. Arbitrary encrypted/custom-VFS state disguised as eligible artifacts is outside the demonstrated contract.

The legacy total_bytes_recovered counter sums logical st_size of successfully unlinked entries. Current labels/comments now say logical bytes removed; no physically released blocks, open-file retention or hardlink allocation are measured.
Only run_cohort_1 is certified for C0219. Other cohorts and the global main still have separate broad operations and were not executed or certified.
Fixtures validate local filesystem behavior, data preservation and fail-closed paths; they do not certify operator runtime, performance, protected native runtime or production campaigns.
